subject: NovusData evaluation: onboarding scope, technical owners, and timeline
messages:
From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Alex Jun <alex.jun@novusdata.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-15T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: NovusData evaluation: onboarding scope, technical owners, and timeline

Hi Alex —

Thanks for the demo last week. Per our conversation I want to get the evaluation scoping and owners aligned so we can move quickly through the technical ramp and produce a clean recommendation to your leadership. Proposed goals for this thread:

- Confirm technical point(s) of contact and their responsibilities
- Agree on a mutual action plan (MAP) with measurement criteria and a target close window
- Surface any redlines/controls (SOC2, data residency, SSO) upfront

Suggested high-level timeline (flexible):
- Week 0 (this week): Kickoff + access checklist and baseline metrics
- Week 1: Inference infra & SSO setup; small-scale run (10k tokens)
- Week 2: Quality checks, latency/cost profiling, and prompts/guardrails tuning
- Week 3: Recommendation + decision (target decision date: 2026-09-10)

Internal owners from Redwood:
- Ben Carter (Solutions Engineer) — technical onboarding, eval instrumentation
- Vivek Kulkarni (Account Exec) — commercial coordination and procurement

Can you confirm the right engineering contact on your side (name, role, email) and whether Novus has a preferred process for granting access to a non-production data slice? If Aug 18 or 19 works, we can do a 30-min technical handshake to align owners.

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Sr. Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

Thanks Kimberly — appreciate the clear plan.

Confirming Priya Suresh (Engineering Lead) will be our primary technical contact: Priya Suresh <priya.s@novusdata.com>. I copied our contracts inbox for visibility on timelines and any standard paperwork.

A couple of items from our side:
- We require SOC2 Type II evidence and an outline of data handling for non-prod slices (we can redact PII on our end)
- Our security team will need SAML metadata for SSO; can your SE surface the SSO process in the kickoff?

Aug 18 at 10:00am PT works for a quick handshake — please send an invite.

Appreciate it,

Subject: Re: NovusData evaluation: onboarding scope, technical owners, and timeline

Great — thanks Alex and Priya. Quick note from the SE side so we can use the kickoff efficiently:

Proposed 30-min kickoff agenda (technical handshake):
1) Introductions & roles (5m)
2) Access & SSO checklist (SAML metadata, service account, IP allowlist) (7m)
3) Eval success criteria and sample slices (what constitutes pass/fail) (8m)
4) Data ingestion and inference flow (model variant, expected concurrency, latency SLO) (7m)
5) Next actions + timeline (3m)

Requests before the kickoff if possible:
- A link to a small non-prod dataset sample or a schema doc (can be sanitized)
- Desired latency and throughput targets (example: p95 < 200ms, concurrency 10)
- A copy of your SSO SAML metadata (or let us share our sso-metadata.xml)

I've attached an evaluation checklist that we use to instrument observability and quality gates — it speeds up ramp and keeps expectations aligned.

Attachment: eval-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet)

If Priya can share any internal acceptance tests you care about (e.g., exact precision/recall thresholds for entity extraction or hallucination tolerances), we can map them to tests in our evaluation harness.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
